wardrobe.description: Consistent cozy bedtime outfit: soft muted teal pajama top, warm cream pajama pants, and simple soft socks. Clothing should stay practical for sitting, holding the jar, walking through the fantasy land, and returning to bed.
No clothing or accessories; keep the companion natural and soft, with no costume pieces.

mustShow: child in cozy pajamas holding the small thunder jar
Leo the gentle lion cub close beside the child
soft grey thunder cloud visible inside the jar
hints of the fantasy thunder land in grey, silver, and night-blue glow
scattered soft blocks on the bedroom floor
coverContract.worldType: Cozy contemporary child's bedroom that opens into a soft, non-scary emotional fantasy world where anger appears as a small thunder cloud in a jar and can be given a safe place.

forbiddenGlobalElements: no real lightning striking people or objects
no fire, smoke damage, or destruction
no broken glass or sharp jar fragments
no frightening monsters inside the cloud
no crowded extra people beyond the supplied cast
no text-heavy signage unless it is part of the story lettering style

hairStyle.value: medium-length, worn loose in a simple everyday style

anchors.description: low child-sized bed with blanket and pillow
soft rug on the floor near the play area
scattered toy blocks from the fallen tower
small corner beside the rug that later becomes the thunder corner

locations.description: A warm, quiet bedroom with a low bed, blanket, rug, scattered toy blocks from a fallen tower, and dim nighttime shadows. The room should feel safe and lived-in, never frightening.
locations.lighting: soft warm bedside glow mixed with gentle blue night shadows
locations.name: Child's bedroom at night
locations.topology: The play floor connects to the bedside area and to the small corner beside the rug. The jar can open an imaginative passage from the bedside/play area into the thunder land.

anchors.description: low soft clouds close to the ground
small puddles that quietly bubble and make tiny boom sounds
small hollow between two wool hills, later edged with soft round stones

locations.description: A gentle fantasy landscape made of soft textures: woolly hills, low clouds, small puddles that make tiny booms, and a path in grey, silver, and night-blue. It represents anger safely, with no danger or destruction.
locations.lighting: moonlit silver-blue glow with soft grey cloud light
locations.name: Land of Thunders
locations.topology: The soft thunder path leads between wool hills to the small hollow. The hollow becomes the thunder pool once soft stones are placed around it.

recurringProps.description: Small clear jar with a lid, held carefully by the child; contains a small grey angry cloud that rumbles and grows heavy until given a place.
recurringProps.material: clear glass-like or acrylic material with a safe rounded lid; should not look breakable or sharp
recurringProps.name: small thunder jar
recurringProps.persistence: appears from page 1 through page 14; weight and cloud behavior change, but jar design remains consistent
recurringProps.scale: small enough for the child to hold with both hands

recurringProps.description: A soft grey cloud inside or emerging from the jar, expressive through shape and movement rather than a face; it can swirl, spread, and settle.
recurringProps.name: small grey thunder cloud
recurringProps.persistence: same anger-cloud throughout; should not become a monster or separate character
recurringProps.scale: starts small inside the jar, can expand like a blanket on the path, then becomes small enough for the thunder pool

recurringProps.description: Soft child-safe blocks from the fallen tower; scattered in the bedroom and later used to make the thunder corner.
recurringProps.name: toy blocks
recurringProps.persistence: scattered from page 1 onward; two blocks are placed in the thunder corner on page 15

recurringProps.description: Soft blanket on the child's bed, used as a hiding place for the jar on page 3 and later part of the calm bedtime scene.
recurringProps.name: bed blanket
recurringProps.persistence: stays with the bed throughout bedroom scenes

recurringProps.description: Round, plush-looking stones used to border the thunder pool; one comically oversized stone can appear during the building moment.
recurringProps.material: felted wool, foam, or plush stone texture
recurringProps.name: soft round stones
recurringProps.persistence: introduced page 11 and remain around the thunder pool through page 14
recurringProps.scale: mostly hand-sized; one stone larger than Leo for the joke on page 11

recurringProps.description: A small contained pool made in the hollow, edged with soft stones, where the thunder cloud can boom gently and safely.
recurringProps.material: soft glowing mist-water with plush stone rim
recurringProps.name: little thunder pool
recurringProps.persistence: formed on page 11, ready on page 12, active pages 13-14
recurringProps.scale: small, child-sized; just large enough for one thunder cloud

recurringProps.description: Small pillow placed with two soft blocks to create a safe thunder corner in the bedroom.
recurringProps.name: small pillow for thunder corner
recurringProps.persistence: introduced page 15 and remains visible page 16

template.worldType: Cozy contemporary child's bedroom that opens into a soft, non-scary emotional fantasy world where anger appears as a small thunder cloud in a jar and can be given a safe place.

low clouds hover close to the path
